QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Where the Star Fell
QuestInfo.0: You told #p2081000# that #p2081004# saw the light from the sky last night. Tell him what #p2081004# said.  \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081000# says the star fell somewhere near #m240010600#. Make sure that the area didn't take any damage.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You checked the area #p2081000# asked about. Thankfully, there was no sign of landslides, but the monsters seemed to be rowdier than usual. They weren't taking any damage!\r\n
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
#questorder1#Go to the shooting star
#questorder2#Hunt monsters
#questorder3#Proceed to [Star Force] Equipment Star Power

0.0: So the light was from a shooting star, hm? But it was so bright!\r\n
0.1: I wonder if it damaged Minar Forest. Yes, it probably caused a landslide. A big one. And it's sliding toward town right now, ready to swallow us all up.
0.2: Go check Minar Forest. I'll warn the others about the landslide. We'll put together an emergency kit or something.\r\n

yes.0: The star fell into the valley outside the village. Around #b#m240010600##k. That's where you should start your search.\r\n

no.0: Even a baby's footstep could cause a landslide in Minar Forest. I've never actually seen it happen, but it doesn't hurt to be prepared.\r\n

1.0: How was the landslide? Was it ginormous? Did it have fangs?

0.msg: (You relay Professor Moon's explanation about the falling star and Star Force to #p2081000#.)

default.0: The star seems to have fallen somewhere around #b#m240010600##k. Please go investigate. I KNOW it caused a landslide.
